## BC Crop Area

This R Markdown document is an annotated set of scripts to combine multiple Statistics Canada (STC) tables related to FCR into one clean file saved in the team's SharePoint data library.

For more information, visit the ReadMe file at <https://github.com/bcgov/nr-af-data-analysis/tree/main/BC%20FCR%20Detailed>. Contact [alstats\@gov.bc.ca](mailto:alstats@gov.bc.ca) for any questions.

There are 6 tables to be loaded from STC. The main FCR table with aggregated data is [Table: 32-10-0045-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210004501) and the other 5 provide more detailed FCR breakdown:

- [Table 32-10-0365-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210036501) Area, production and farm gate value of marketed vegetables

- [Table 32-10-0364-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210036401) Area, production and farm gate value of marketed fruits

- [Table 32-10-0456-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210045601) Production and value of greenhouse fruits and vegetables

- [Table 32-10-0246-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210024601) Production and sale of greenhouse flowers and plants

- [Table 32-10-0452-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210045201) Estimates of field-grown cut flowers area, production and sales

- [Table: 32-10-0356-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/cv.action?pid=3210035601) Area, production and sales of mushrooms

This script generally loads the above tables into the environment based on the specified date cut-off then, using a specified set of vectors, filters the data frame (or DF) and cleans it Specific steps are:

A.  Set-up and load library

B.  Load detailed field vegetable FCR breakdown and calculate "Other field vegetables" from total field vegetable in main FCR table as residual

C.  Load detailed fruit FCR breakdown and calculate "Other fresh fruits" from total fruits in main FCR table as residual

D.  Load detailed greenhouse fruits & veg and calculate "Other GH veg" from total GH veg in main FCR table as residual. Note that Strawberries are excluded from total GH veg and considered a GH fruit

E.  Load sod from the main FCR table and interpolate linearly because 2018 is suppressed. Then load the total floriculture, nursery and sod form the main FCR table as well as floriculture and append the interpolated sod table to calculate nursery total (also suppressed in 2018). Load floriculture field and subtract from total floriculture to calculate GH floriculture. Load GH floriculture and nursery, subtract GH floriculture to calculate GH nursery then subtract GH nursery from total nursery to get field nursery estimate.

F.  Load the main FCR table for other commodities that do not have further breakdown and calculate "other crops" as the difference between total crop FCR less all other breakdowns from **AllFiledVegFCR, AllFruitsFCR, AllGHFruitFCR, AllGHVegFCR, AllOtherCropsFCR** and save into **AllCropsFCR**

G.  Hard code the FCR reference table for crosswalk

H.  Append all tables (**AllCropsFCR**) then left-join with the crosswalk

I.  Write .csv and save into data library

## A. Set-up and load library

In addition to loading necessary packages from the library, this chunk of code also specifies the date cut-off by which the data will be filtered by.

```{r Set-up}

# Load library
library(pacman)
p_load(cansim,
       dplyr,
       data.table,
       tidyr,
       lubridate,
       tictoc,
       splitstackshape,
       stringr,
       zoo,
       tibble)

```

## B. Mushroom Area

Insert transformations here

\# Add commodity variable

```{r}

# Load the Mushroom table
MushroomArea <- get_cansim("32-10-0356")

# Clean the MushroomArea dataframe
MushroomArea <- MushroomArea %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year, GEO and Estimates to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    Estimates = as.character(Estimates),
    GEO = as.character(GEO)
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep total area harvested
  filter(
    Estimates == "Area harvested, total"
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia"
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only the latest year available
  filter(
    Date >= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 10
  ) %>%
  
  # Convert square feet to hectares
  mutate(
    val_norm = val_norm / 107639.104
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename val_norm to Hectares
  rename(
    Hectares = val_norm
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Hectares)

# Add commodity variable 
MushroomArea$Commodity <- "Fresh & processed mushrooms"
```

## C. Field Vegetable Area

1.  Load the mushroom estimates ([Table: 32-10-0356-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/cv.action?pid=3210035601) in DF called **MushroomFCR**)

2.  After loading detailed field vegetable FCR breakdown, load the total field veg from the main FCR table and and calculate "Other field vegetables". The calculation is done by appending **MushroomFCR** and detailed field veg estimates ([Table 32-10-0456-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210045601) in DF called **FieldVegFCR**) with total field veg estimate ([Table: 32-10-0045-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210004501) in DF called **FCR_TotalFieldVeg**) to create a new DF called **AllFieldVeg**.

3.  The DF **AllFieldVeg** is then pivoted wider and "Other field vegetables" is calculated by subtracting the sum of broken down field vegetable estimates from the total field vegetable estimate.

4.  The total field vegetable estimate column is then dropped to avoid double counting and the entire **AllFieldVeg** DF is pivoted longer for appending with other DFs to create the full detailed FCR DF.

5.  Fresh cabbage should equal Fresh regular cabbage + Fresh Chinese cabbage + Fresh kale but it is not always the case. For now, only Fresh cabbage is loaded but additional work to calculate "other cabbage" could be done. Similarly, Fresh radishes should equal Fresh radishes (except Asian radishes) + Fresh Asian radishes and other radishes need to be calculated for future iterations of this code to show that breakdown.

```{r FieldVeg}
tic()

# Load the Potatoes Area table
PotatoesArea <- get_cansim("32-10-0358") 

# Clean the PotatoesArea dataframe
PotatoesArea <- PotatoesArea %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year and Area to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    `Area, production and farm value of potatoes` = as.character(`Area, production and farm value of potatoes`)
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only the latest year available
  filter(
    Date >= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 11
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia"
  ) %>%
  
  
  # Filter only for harvested area
  filter(
    `Area, production and farm value of potatoes` == "Harvested area"
  ) %>%
  
  # Convert acres to hectares
  mutate(
    val_norm = val_norm * 0.404686
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename variables
  rename(
    Hectares = val_norm
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Hectares)

# Add commodity variable 
PotatoesArea$Commodity <- "Fresh potatoes"

# Load the Field Vegetable table
FieldVegArea <- get_cansim("32-10-0365") 

# Clean the FieldVegArea dataframe
FieldVegArea <- FieldVegArea %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year and Estimates to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    Commodity = as.character(Commodity),
    Estimates = as.character(Estimates)
  ) %>%

  # Keep only the latest year available
  filter(
    Date >= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 10
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for area planted in hectares
  filter(
    Estimates == "Area planted (hectares)"
  ) %>%
  
  # Exclude these commodities
  filter(
    !Commodity %in% c(
      "Total fresh vegetables",
      "Fresh Chinese cabbage",
      "Fresh regular cabbage",
      "Fresh kale",
      "Fresh Asian radishes",
      "Fresh radishes (except Asian radishes)"
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename commodity categories
  mutate(
    Commodity = case_when(
      Commodity == "Fresh cucumbers" ~ "Fresh cucumbers and fresh gherkins (all varieties)",
      Commodity == "Other fresh vegetables" ~ "Other field vegetables",
      TRUE ~ Commodity
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename val_norm to Hectares
  rename(
  Hectares = val_norm
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Commodity, Hectares)

# Append Potatoes and Field Veg
FieldVegArea <- bind_rows(
  PotatoesArea,
  FieldVegArea)


(toc)
```

## D. Fruits Area

1.  After loading detailed fruits FCR breakdown into DF called **FruitsFCR** from [Table 32-10-0364-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210036401), load the total fresh fruits, apples, blueberries, strawberries, grapes and cranberries from the main FCR table ([Table: 32-10-0045-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210004501)) into **FCR_TotalFruits** DF by appending both DFs to each other in a new DF called **AllFruitsFCR**.That DF is then pivoted wider to calculate "Other fresh fruits" by subtracting all broken down fruit FCR estimates from the total fruit FCR.

2.  Fresh apples, blueberries, cranberries, grapes and strawberries come from the main FCR table ([Table: 32-10-0045-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210004501)) rather than [Table 32-10-0364-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210036401) because the latter is released earlier and the former are re-estimates from STC.

3.  Note that currants, haskaps and fresh sour cherries are not loaded because it causes the "Other fresh fruits" to be negative for certain years and are counted as "other fresh fruits".

4.  Breakdown between highbush vs. lowbush blueberries and labrusca vs. vinifera grapes not yet loaded and residual will need to be calculated from total blueberries and total grapes

Similar to field vegetables, the total fruits column is dropped and then **AllFRuitsFCR** is pivoted long for appending with other detailed FCR tables.

```{r Fruits}

tic()

# Load the detailed Fruit table
FruitsArea <- get_cansim("32-10-0364") 


# Clean the FruitsArea dataframe
FruitsArea <- FruitsArea %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year, Commodity and Estimates to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    Commodity = as.character(Commodity),
    Estimates = as.character(Estimates)
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only the latest year available
  filter(
    Date >= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 10
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for bearing area
  filter(
    Estimates == "Bearing area"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for Hectares
  filter(
    `Farm area, production, value` == "Hectares"
  ) %>%
  
  # Exclude these commodities
  filter(
    !Commodity %in% c(
      "Total fresh fruit",
      "Fresh highbush blueberries",
      "Fresh lowbush blueberries",
      "Fresh Labrusca grapes",
      "Fresh vinifera, fresh French hybrid grapes"
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename commodity categories
  mutate(
    Commodity = case_when(
      Commodity == "Other fresh fruit, n.e.c." ~ "Other fresh fruits",
      TRUE ~ Commodity
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename val_norm to Hectares
  rename(
    Hectares = val_norm
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Commodity, Hectares)

toc()
```

## E. Greenhouse Fruits & Vegetables Area

1.  The only greenhouse fruit with detailed FCR estimate is strawberries, or vector v1271897860 so the first part of the chunk of code below builds the AllGHFruitFCR table using that vector.

2.  The next part is to load the detailed GH vegetable breakdown from [Table 32-10-0456-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210045601) and we replace "fresh" with GH to distinguish from field-grown vegetables. The total GH vegetables is pulled from main FCR table, [Table: 32-10-0045-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210004501), then appended with the detailed GH vegetables. Other GH vegetables is then calculated as the difference between total GH vegetables from the main FCR table, [Table: 32-10-0045-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210004501) and the sum of GH vegetable breakdown from [Table 32-10-0456-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210045601).

```{r GHFruitVeg}

tic()

# Load the GH Veg table
GHFruitVegArea <- get_cansim("32-10-0456") 

# Clean the GHFruitVegArea dataframe
GHFruitVegArea <- GHFruitVegArea %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year,  Commodity and Estimates to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    Commodity = as.character(Commodity),
    Estimates = as.character(Estimates),
    `Production and value` = as.character(`Production and value`)
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only the latest year available
  filter(
    Date >= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 10
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for area
  filter(
    Estimates == "Square feet"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for acres
  filter(
    `Production and value` == "Area harvested"
  ) %>%
  
  # Exclude these commodities
  filter(
    !Commodity == "Fresh sprouts"
  ) %>%

  # Convert square feet to acres
  mutate(
    val_norm = val_norm / 107639.104
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename val_norm to Hectares
  rename(
    Hectares = val_norm
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Commodity, Hectares)

# Replace fresh with GH
GHFruitVegArea$Commodity <- gsub("Fresh", "GH", GHFruitVegArea$Commodity)
GHFruitVegArea$Commodity <- gsub("fresh", "GH", GHFruitVegArea$Commodity)

toc()
```

## F. Sod Area

Starting by loading sod (vector v44179596) FCR from the main FCR table, [Table: 32-10-0045-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210004501) into the DF called **FCR_Sod**. This is then cleaned and renamed to **AllSodFCR**. Missing or suppressed values are then linearly interpolated (see note below).

```{r Sod}

# Load the Sod table
SodArea <- get_cansim("32-10-0034") 

# Clean the SodArea dataframe
SodArea <- SodArea %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year, Estimates and area to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    Estimates = as.character(Estimates),
    `Area sales and resales` = as.character(`Area sales and resales`)
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only the latest year available
  filter(
    Date >= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 10
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for area
  filter(
    Estimates == "Hectares"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for acres
  filter(
    `Area sales and resales` == "Total sod area"
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename val_norm to Hectares
  rename(
    Hectares = val_norm
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Hectares)

# Add commodity variable 
SodArea$Commodity <- "Sod"
```

## G. Nursery 

1.  Then, load the total floriculture, nursery and sod, Floriculture and nursery products, and sod from the main FCR table, [Table: 32-10-0045-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210004501), into the **FCR_FNS** DF which is pivoted wider to calculate nursery total as the difference between the total less floriculture, and sod and saved as the DF called **AllNurseryFCR**.

2.  Using the DF **FCR_FNS**, create a new DF by keeping only Floriculture products (except flower seeds), . Load FloricultureField (vector v112281450 from [Table 32-10-0452-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210045201)) into a DF called **FloricultureField** and append/bind rows in **FCR_FNS** and **FloricultureField** into a DF called **AllFloricultureFCR**.

3.  Linearly predict 2015 field floriculture because the data set only goes back to 2016. Then, calculate [GH floriculture]`=[`Floriculture products (except flower seeds)]`-[`Field-grown cut flowers].

4.  The DF **FCR_GH_Floriculture_Nursery** is loaded from [Table 32-10-0246-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210024601) and grouped by summing total value to a DF called **FCR_GH_Floriculture_Nursery** then assigned commodity called "GH Floriculture & Nursery".

5.  Create a new DF called **GHFloricultureFCR** by filtering **AllFloricultureFCR** for only GH Floriculture.

6.  Load FCR for GH floriculture and nursery into DF called **FCR_GH_Floriculture_Nursery** from

7.  Bind rows/append DF **FCR_GH_Floriculture_Nursery** and **GHFloricultureFCR** into a new DF called **FCR_GHNursery**, pivot wide then calculate GH floriculture from Floriculture products (except flowers and seeds) less Field-grown cut flowers. In other words:

    GH floriculture = Total floriculture - Field-grown floriculture

8.  Bind rows/append DF **GHFloricultureFCR** with DF **FCR_GH_Floriculture_Nursery** and pivot wide to a new DF called **FCR_GHNursery** to calculate GH Nursery from GH floriculure & nursery less GH Floriculture or in other words:

    GH Nursery = GH Floriculture & Nursery - GH Floriculture

9.  Append All Nursery (DF called **AllNurseryFCR**) with GH nursery (DF called **FCR_GHNursery**), pivot wide and calculate field nursery (column called **Field Nursery**) as difference between all nusery less GH nursery. Pivot the entire DF long into **AllNurseryFCR**

A note on time series interpolation: This method estimates missing values based on trends in the available data where up to 2 years of data in the same category are suppressed but values exist before and after. Linear interpolation is used to address missing values for Nursery and Sod. The following code creates the column `value_interp`, which duplicates `val_norm` and estimates missing values for up to 2 years of consecutive missing data in each category. Currently, this step is only done for floriculture, nursery and sod because 2018 values for nursery and sod are suppressed.

```{r Nursery}

tic()

# Load the Nursery Area table
NurseryArea <- get_cansim("32-10-0029") 

# Clean the NurseryArea dataframe
NurseryArea <- NurseryArea %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year, Estimates amd Area to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    Estimates = as.character(Estimates),
    Area = as.character(Area)
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only the latest year available
  filter(
    Date >= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 10
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for area
  filter(
    Estimates == "Hectares"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for area
  filter(
    Area %in% c(
      "Total field area",
      "Total container area"
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename variables
  rename(
    Hectares = val_norm,
    Commodity = Area
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename commodity categories
  mutate(
    Commodity = case_when(
      Commodity == "Total field area" ~ "Field Nursery",
      Commodity == "Total container area" ~ "GH Nursery",
      TRUE ~ Commodity
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Hectares, Commodity)

toc()
```

## H. Floriculture

```{r Floriculture}

tic()

# Load the GH Floriculture Area table
GHFloricultureArea <- get_cansim("32-10-0019") 

# Clean the GHFloricultureArea dataframe
GHFloricultureArea <- GHFloricultureArea %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year, Estimates, Area and Producer type to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    Estimates = as.character(Estimates),
    Area = as.character(Area),
    `Producer type` = as.character(`Producer type`)
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only the latest year available
  filter(
    Date >= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 10
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for Square feet
  filter(
    Estimates == "Square feet"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for total greenhouse operations
  filter(
    Area == "Total greenhouse area"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for producer type
  filter(
    `Producer type` == "Specialized greenhouse flowers and plants"
  ) %>%
  
  # Convert square feet to acres
  mutate(
    val_norm = val_norm / 107639.104
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename variables
  rename(
    Hectares = val_norm,
    Commodity = Area
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename commodity categories
  mutate(
    Commodity = case_when(
      Commodity == "Total greenhouse area" ~ "GH floriculture",
      TRUE ~ Commodity
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Hectares, Commodity)

# Load the Field Floriculture Area table
FieldFloricultureArea <- get_cansim("32-10-0452") 

# Clean the FieldFloricultureArea dataframe
FieldFloricultureArea <- FieldFloricultureArea %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year and Estimates to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    Estimates = as.character(Estimates),
    `Area, production, and sales` = as.character(`Area, production, and sales`)
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only the latest year available
  filter(
    Date >= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 10
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for Hectares
  filter(
    Estimates == "Hectares"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for total field-grown flowers
  filter(
    `Area, production, and sales` == "Total field-grown flowers area"
  ) %>%
  
    # Rename variables
  rename(
    Hectares = val_norm,
    Commodity = `Area, production, and sales`
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename commodity categories
  mutate(
    Commodity = case_when(
      Commodity == "Total field-grown flowers area" ~ "Field-grown flowers",
      TRUE ~ Commodity
    )
  ) %>%

  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Hectares, Commodity)

# Append both GH and field grown flowers
FloricultureArea <- bind_rows(
  FieldFloricultureArea,
  GHFloricultureArea)

# Drop these DFs
rm(FieldFloricultureArea,
   GHFloricultureArea)

toc()
```

## I. Cannabis & Christmas Trees

This chunk of code pulls the remaining commodities from the main FCR table, [Table: 32-10-0045-01](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3210004501), into a DF called AllOtherCropsFCR. After cleaning, it is appended/row bind with all other crop DFs (**AllFiledVegFCR, AllFruitsFCR, AllGHFruitFCR, AllGHVegFCR, AllOtherCropsFCR**) into the DF called **AllCropsFCR**.

Other crops is calculated as the difference between Total crop receipts and all other crop breakdowns and saved into **AllCropsFCR**\$Other crops.

Note that deferred grain receipts are added rather than subtracted because its a negative number.

```{r ChristmasTree}

tic()

# Load the Christmas Tree Area table
ChristmasTreeArea <- get_cansim("32-10-0249") 

# Clean the ChristmasTreeArea dataframe
ChristmasTreeArea <- ChristmasTreeArea %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year, Estimates amd Area to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    `Land use` = as.character(`Land use`),
    `Unit of measure` = as.character(`Unit of measure`)
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only the latest year available
  filter(
    Date >= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 10
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia [PR590000000]"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for area
  filter(
    `Unit of measure` == "Hectares"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for area
  filter(
    `Land use` == "Christmas trees grown for sale"
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename variables
  rename(
    Hectares = val_norm,
    Commodity = `Land use`
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename commodity categories
  mutate(
    Commodity = case_when(
      Commodity == "Christmas trees grown for sale" ~ "Christmas trees",
      TRUE ~ Commodity
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename GEO categories
  mutate(
    GEO = case_when(
      GEO == "British Columbia [PR590000000]" ~ "British Columbia",
      TRUE ~ GEO
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Hectares, Commodity)

toc()
```

## J. Field Crops Area

```{r FieldCrops}

# Start timer
tic()

# Load the Field Crops Area table
FieldCropsArea <- get_cansim("32-10-0359") 

# Clean the FieldCropsArea dataframe
FieldCropsArea <- FieldCropsArea %>%
  
  # Convert Date to year, Harvest disposition and Type of crop to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    `Harvest disposition` = as.character(`Harvest disposition`),
    `Type of crop` = as.character(`Type of crop`)
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep the latest complete year and 10 years prior
  filter(
    Date >= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 11,
    Date <= max(Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 1
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only British Columbia
  filter(
    GEO == "British Columbia"
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep selected field crops
  filter(
    `Type of crop` %in% c(
      "Canola (rapeseed)",
      "Wheat, all excluding durum wheat",
      "Oats",
      "Barley",
      "Peas, dry",
      "Rye, all",
      "Tame hay"
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter only for area
  filter(
    `Harvest disposition` == "Harvested area (hectares)"
  ) %>%
  
    # Rename variables
  rename(
    Hectares = val_norm,
    Commodity = `Type of crop`
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename commodity categories
  mutate(
    Commodity = case_when(
      Commodity == "Canola (rapeseed)" ~ "Canola (including rapeseed)",
      Commodity == "Wheat, all excluding durum wheat" ~ "Wheat (except durum wheat)",
      Commodity == "Peas, dry" ~ "Dry peas",
      Commodity == "Rye, all" ~ "Rye",
      Commodity == "Tame hay" ~ "Hay",
      TRUE ~ Commodity
    )
  ) %>%

  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, Hectares, Commodity)

toc()
```

## L. Append All Tables and Join Crosswalk

Append AllCropsFCR, AllLIvestockFCR and AllDirectPaymentsFCR into a DF called All_FCR_Detailed.

```{r Append}

# Append All tables
All_CropsArea <- bind_rows(
  FieldCropsArea,
  FieldVegArea,
  FloricultureArea,
  FruitsArea,
  GHFruitVegArea,
  MushroomArea,
  NurseryArea,
  ChristmasTreeArea,
  SodArea)

# left join with reference table
All_CropsArea <- All_CropsArea %>%
  left_join(Crops_Crosswalk, by = "Commodity")

```

## M. Write .csv and save into data library

As of August 2026, SITS cannot yet directly connect to a SharePoint URL to access the shared Unpublished Data library. The interim workaround is to sync that library to the user's Desktop and change the URL manually. Remember to replace "\\" with "/" and note that the timeout settings is 10 mins because the zip file is large and the default timeout of 1 min is insufficient to download and unzip the file.

Until BC Gov admins grant access, SharePoint files cannot easily be pulled using the **M365** R package. The temporary workaround is to sync the Unpublished Data Library with each user's desktop which needs to be updated in the code:

```         
"C:/Users/[replace with IDIR]/Government of BC/SICI Data Library Subsite - Unpublished Data"
```

```{r Write}

# Set working directory
setwd("C:/Users/lebautis/Government of BC/SICI Data Library Subsite - Unpublished Data")

# Load detailed BC FCR data
BC_FCR_Detailed <- fread(
  "C:/Users/lebautis/Government of BC/SICI Data Library Subsite - Unpublished Data/BC_FCR_Detailed.csv"
)

# Drop selected sectors and commodities
BC_FCR_Detailed <- BC_FCR_Detailed %>%
  
  # Exclude livestock and direct program payments
  filter(
    !Sector %in% c(
      "Livestock",
      "Direct program payments"
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # Exclude deferred grain receipt commodities
  filter(
    !Commodity %in% c(
      "Liquidation of deferred grain receipts",
      "Deferred grain receipts"
    )
  )

# Join area and value data and calculate value per hectare
Value_PerHectare <- BC_FCR_Detailed %>%
  left_join(
    All_CropsArea,
    by = c("Commodity", "Date", "Sector", "Group", "GEO")
  ) %>%
  
  # Calculate value per hectare
  mutate(
    ValuePerHectare = Value / Hectares
  )

# Write the csv file

fwrite(Value_PerHectare, "C:/Users/lebautis/Government of BC/SICI Data Library Subsite - Unpublished Data/BC_Value_PerHectare.csv")

```
